n_definition: Each cell's n counts eligible repetitions. Each repetition uses three prompts. The value is the mean of the repetition estimates, and sd is their sample standard deviation.
acceptance_definition: Each repetition pools committed tokens and verification rounds before calculating mean acceptance length. The numerator includes retained target tokens before final output trimming.
scope_note: Primary request records supply timing and verification-round counts. Detailed phase timing and memory use separate diagnostic runs. GPU efficiency uses timed benchmark intervals and a matching final Slurm allocation. Whole-job totals retain a separate scope.

counter_semantics.committed_token_formula: Accepted draft tokens plus verification rounds, before output trimming and excluding the initial target token.

definitions.metric-prefix-survival: For EAGLE-3, count verification rounds whose proposal tree contains a node at the stated depth. Among those rounds, count rounds whose accepted path reaches that depth. Divide accepted rounds by eligible rounds. Depth one contains the root's children. The root is a previously generated target token. Counts precede final output clipping.
definitions.metric-conditional-acceptance: For EAGLE-3, count verification rounds whose accepted path reaches the preceding depth and has at least one proposed child at the stated depth. Among those rounds, count rounds that accept a child. Divide accepted rounds by eligible rounds and multiply by 100. A leaf has no eligible next proposal. Counts precede final output clipping.

tree_variant_definitions.paper_convention: These tree-prefix diagnostics use the recorded branching tree. The EAGLE-3 paper measures n-alpha with a chain and defines n by the draft feature history. The tree values preserve their separate interpretation.
